description: Defines classes and functions for buffer allocation and management within the quiche library, including QuicheBufferAllocator, QuicheBufferDeleter, QuicheBuffer, and related utilities.

classes.name: QuicheBufferAllocator
classes.description: Abstract base class for buffer allocators, providing methods for creating and deleting buffers.

classes.name: QuicheBufferDeleter
classes.description: Deleter class for managing buffer ownership with std::unique_ptr.

classes.name: QuicheBuffer
classes.description: Mutable buffer class with associated size, supporting copy and move semantics.

methods.name: MakeUniqueBuffer
methods.description: Creates a unique pointer to a buffer allocated by a QuicheBufferAllocator.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Creates a QuicheBuffer containing a copy of provided data.

methods.name: CopyFromIovec
methods.description: Creates a QuicheBuffer by copying data from an iovec array.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases ownership of the buffer from a QuicheBuffer.
